title: AcademicConfidenceEvidenceContract
description: Contract schema for evidence-derived confidence factors (evidence strength, independence, generalization, validation, and contradiction penalties).

computed_confidence.description: The final evidence-derived confidence score bounded between 0.0 and 1.0.

evidence_strength.description: Strength factor based on sample/task quality, failure severity, and experience volume.

independence.description: Independence factor based on distinct sessions and independent observation ratio.

generalization.description: Generalization factor based on context diversity and 7-stage ladder position.

validation.description: Validation factor based on performance across Regression, Adversarial, and Held-out suites.

contradiction_penalty.description: Penalty subtracted for active contradictions, regressions, or boundary violations.

independent_experiences_count.description: Total number of verified underlying experiences.

unique_sessions_count.description: Number of distinct sessions, conversations, or projects.

distinct_designs_count.description: Number of distinct experimental designs represented.

distinct_domains_count.description: Number of distinct scientific disciplines represented.

generalization_stage.description: Current position in the 7-stage generalization ladder.

regression_score.description: Pass rate or performance score on Regression suite.

adversarial_score.description: Pass rate or performance score on Adversarial suite.

heldout_score.description: Pass rate or performance score on Held-Out suite.

contradictions_count.description: Number of active unresolved contradictions or competing paradigms.

regressions_count.description: Number of documented regressions on baseline capabilities.

evaluated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when confidence was calculated.
